I'm Tristan Labagala, a Monash University Commerce and IT student majoring in Business Analytics and Business Information Systems, graduating in November 2026. The problems I like most start with messy data and end with a decision someone has to make. As a finance intern at JBS Pork Australia, that meant reconciling freight costs across the SAP and CSB ERP systems and building Excel dashboards that compared forecasts and budgets with actuals. At the Monash Statistical Analytics Club I lead a team of student analysts, which won Best Team at the inaugural Data Analytics Initiative Pitch Night in October 2026.
